title: Week 4
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. Sunday's batch chicken and roasted vegetables carry eight of this week's meals.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Store-bought BBQ sauce often hides Worcestershire (anchovies), so this week's BBQ sauce is homemade. Peanut butter is often made in plants that also handle tree nuts. If your allergy is strict, check the label for a 'may contain tree nuts' line.
weekendNote: Festival days. Leftovers waiting for you: a bowl of tortilla soup and a portion of peanut noodles.

mon.heads: Everything today comes straight from Sunday's prep. Dinner makes Wednesday's lunch.

wed.heads: Tonight, move the 4 frozen chicken portions to the fridge for Thursday and Friday. Dinner makes Thursday's lunch.

prep.title: Sunday batch prep
prep.makes: 9 portions of shredded chicken, 2 trays of roasted vegetables, rice, ranch, BBQ sauce, 3 jars of oats, 6 eggs
steps: Start the batch chicken in the crock pot first thing (low 6 hours or high 3½).
Heat the oven to 425°F. Prick 2 sweet potatoes and put them straight on the rack for 45 to 50 minutes.
Chop the broccoli, zucchini, peppers, red onion and 1 more sweet potato. Roast on 2 sheet pans for 25 minutes, swapping the pans halfway.
Cook 2 cups of rice.
Make the yogurt ranch and simmer the honey BBQ sauce for 5 minutes.
Mix 3 jars of berry overnight oats. Air-fry 6 eggs at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Shred the chicken in its juices and portion it: 2 for buffalo bowls, 2 for BBQ sweet potatoes, 1 for lemon pasta in the fridge.
Freeze the other 4 portions (2 for soup, 2 for peanut noodles). Cooked chicken keeps 3 to 4 days, so the end of the week waits in the freezer.
Pack 2 buffalo bowls. Keep the sauces in jars.

prep.title: Wednesday night
prep.makes: Steak dinner for two plus Thursday's lunch
steps: Move the 4 frozen chicken portions to the fridge.
Cook 1 cup of rice if you are low.
Sear the steak bites, then pack one portion with rice and roasted vegetables for Thursday.

batch-chicken.name: Crock-pot batch shredded chicken
steps: Season the chicken all over with 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper.
Lay it in the crock pot with the quartered onion and 4 smashed garlic cloves.
Pour in 1 cup chicken broth.
Cook on low 6 hours or high 3½ hours.
Shred with two forks and stir it back into the juices so it stays moist.
Portion into 9 containers of about 1 cup. Fridge 5, freeze 4.
batch-chicken.tip: Seasoned plainly on purpose, so it can turn buffalo, BBQ, lemony, Mexican or Thai later in the week.

roast-veg.name: Two-tray roasted vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the broccoli crowns into florets, the zucchini into half-moons, the bell peppers into chunks, the red onion into wedges and the sweet potato into ¾-inch cubes.
Toss everything with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning and 1½ tsp salt, and spread it over 2 sheet pans so nothing is crowded.
Roast 25 minutes, swapping the pans and stirring halfway, until browned at the edges.
Cool, then store in one big container.

yogurt-ranch.name: Greek yogurt ranch
steps: Stir 1 cup Greek yogurt, the juice of ½ lemon, 1 tsp dried dill, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper together with 2 tbsp water.
Taste for salt. It keeps a week in a jar.

honey-bbq.name: Honey BBQ sauce
steps: Whisk ¾ cup ketchup, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp yellow mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder and a pinch of salt in a small pot.
Simmer 5 minutes, stirring, until it thickens a little.
Cool and keep in a jar.
honey-bbq.tip: Homemade so there is no hidden Worcestershire.

overnight-oats.name: Berry peanut butter overnight oats
steps: Stir 1½ cups milk, 1½ cups Greek yogurt, 3 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt together.
Stir in 1½ cups oats and split across 3 jars.
Top each with ½ cup frozen berries. They thaw overnight into a jammy layer.
Keeps 4 days. Eat cold or warm.

egg-scramble.name: Spinach feta scramble with toast
steps: Toast 2 slices of whole wheat bread.
Wilt a big handful of spinach in a skillet coated with cooking spray for 1 minute.
Whisk 3 eggs, add them and stir gently over medium-low until just set.
Fold in 2 tbsp feta and season with a pinch of salt and black pepper.

hb-eggs.name: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs straight into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then refrigerate.
Peel and sprinkle with a pinch of salt to eat.

buffalo-bowl.name: Buffalo chicken ranch bowl
steps: Toss 2 portions of shredded chicken with 3 tbsp hot sauce.
Pack ¾ cup rice, 1 cup roasted vegetables and half the buffalo chicken in each container.
Reheat 2 minutes, then drizzle with 3 tbsp ranch and top with sliced green onion.
buffalo-bowl.tip: Built from Sunday's batch chicken, vegetables and ranch.

bbq-sweet-potato.name: BBQ chicken stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Warm 2 portions of shredded chicken with ⅓ cup honey BBQ sauce.
Split the baked sweet potatoes, fluff the insides and reheat 2 minutes.
Pile in the BBQ chicken and ¼ cup cheddar, and air-fry at 380°F for 3 minutes to melt it if you like.
Toss 1 cup coleslaw mix with 2 tbsp ranch and pile it on top with sliced green onion.
Pack the second one for Wednesday's lunch.

lemon-chicken-pasta.name: Lemon garlic chicken pasta
steps: Boil 4 oz spaghetti in salted water and save a splash of the water.
Warm 2 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of red pepper flakes in 1 tbsp olive oil for 1 minute.
Add the shredded chicken and 1 cup roasted vegetables for 2 minutes, then a handful of spinach.
Toss in the pasta, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with 2 tbsp feta and salt to taste.

steak-bites.name: Garlic steak bites with roasted vegetables
steps: Pat the steak dry and season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in the cast iron until smoking. Sear the steak in one layer for 2 minutes without moving it, then toss for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Turn off the heat and stir in 4 minced garlic cloves and a pinch of red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Reheat 3 cups roasted vegetables in the same pan.
Serve over ¾ cup rice each with sliced green onion. Pack one portion for Thursday.
steak-bites.tip: Steak night for two. It makes Thursday's lunch too.

tortilla-soup.name: 15-minute chicken tortilla soup
steps: Soften ½ diced onion in 1 tsp olive oil for 4 minutes. Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp chili powder and ½ tsp dried oregano for 30 seconds.
Add 3 cups chicken broth, the fire-roasted tomatoes, the rinsed black beans and 1 cup corn, and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in 2 portions of shredded chicken to heat through and finish with the juice of 1 lime.
Top with cheddar, a spoonful of yogurt, cilantro and a handful of crushed tortilla chips.
Pack one bowl for Friday's lunch.
tortilla-soup.tip: Built from Sunday's chicken. Dinner after Thursday pickleball, lunch on Friday.

thai-peanut-noodles.name: Thai peanut chicken noodles
steps: Boil 8 oz spaghetti and save ½ cup of the water.

Whisk ⅓ cup peanut butter, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, the juice of 1½ limes, 1 grated garlic clove, ½ tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp sesame oil and a pinch of red pepper flakes with ¼ cup hot water until smooth.
Warm 2 portions of shredded chicken and 2 cups roasted vegetables (mostly peppers and broccoli) in a large skillet.
Add the noodles, sauce and 1½ cups coleslaw mix and toss over low heat, loosening with pasta water.
Finish with cilantro, sliced green onion and a squeeze of the last ½ lime.
thai-peanut-noodles.tip: This week's new one, and a dinner for two. Peanut sauce is safe for you; tree nuts are not.
